Walking down Madison, a guy throws his shoulder into me and keeps walking. 

I turn around. He does it, on purpose, to 3 others. 

We all look back, puzzled, and an older dude comes up to us. 

“Don’t worry. I saw what he did. I threw him an elbow for ya.”

That’s Chicago.
